author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇺🇸🇨🇳 Trump took Xi Jinping to see America’s founding documents, then immediately put the history gap into perspective.

“𝘖𝘶𝘳𝘴 𝘨𝘰𝘦𝘴 250 𝘺𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘴… 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘪𝘳𝘴 𝘨𝘰𝘦𝘴 6,000 𝘺𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘴.”

Then he added, almost defensively:

“𝘞𝘦’𝘳𝘦 𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘺 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘥 𝘰𝘧 𝘰𝘶𝘳 250.”

If your 250 years are on par with 6,000 there is plenty of reason to be proud.

Writers: Sol, Oliver
